table.retrieve:
SELECT
	purinvcode = dbo.purledger.purinvcode,    
	date = dbo.purledger.date, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.purledger.invgstperc1, 
	invtype = 
		Case dbo.purledger.purcatcode 	
			When 1 Then 'Pack Cash Purchase' 	
			When 2 Then 'Pack Credit Purchase' 
			When 7 Then 'Loose Purchase Cash'
			When 8 Then 'Loose Purchase Credit'
		Else 'Opening Purchase' End,
	invdiscperc=dbo.purledger.discperc,	   
	manufacturer=
		(SELECT manufacturer.name 
		FROM manufacturer 
		WHERE manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
	looseqty = dbo.purdetail.looseqty, 
	packqty  = purdetail.packqty, 
	quantity = dbo.purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty, 
	bonusqty  = purdetail.bonusqty, 	  
	price = dbo.purdetail.purprice,    
	unitsalestax = purdetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc = purdetail.gstperc,	
	itemdiscperc = dbo.purdetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.purdetail.packunits,    
	packing=  case when dbo.item.packcode is null then space(30)
	else  dbo.itempacking.name
	end,
	batch = dbo.purdetail.batch,    
	expiry = dbo.purdetail.expiry,    
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, purledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, purledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, purledger.date)))), 
	Supplier = dbo.accounts.name,
	suppalias=accounts.aliasname,
	Posted=dbo.purledger.posted,
	salePrice=
		CASE 
			WHEN dbo.purledger.purcatcode <=2 THEN item.saleprice  
			ELSE item.saleprice/CASE WHEN item.packunits > 0 THEN item.packunits ELSE 1 END
		END,
	margin=((Case WHEN dbo.purledger.purcatcode <=2 THEN item.saleprice ELSE item.saleprice / CASE WHEN item.packunits > 0 THEN item.packunits ELSE 1 END
				 END) - 
				((((purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty) * purdetail.purprice) * (1 - purdetail.discperc * .01) )  * (1 - purledger.discperc * 0.01) ) /  
					CASE WHEN (purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty) > 0 THEN 
						( purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty ) 
					ELSE 1 END 
				) * 100 / 
							case  when (CASE WHEN dbo.purledger.purcatcode <=2 THEN item.saleprice ELSE item.saleprice / (CASE WHEN item.packunits > 0 THEN item.packunits ELSE 1 END) END)=0 then 1
							else (CASE WHEN dbo.purledger.purcatcode <=2 THEN item.saleprice ELSE item.saleprice / (CASE WHEN item.packunits > 0 THEN item.packunits ELSE 1 END) END)
							end
FROM 	 
	dbo.purledger, 
	dbo.purdetail,    
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  
	dbo.purledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.purledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.purledger.posted = 'Y' and  
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode = dbo.purdetail.purinvcode and  
	dbo.purdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.item.manfcode IN (:ai_manfcode) and
	dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
table.sort: manufacturer A, date A, purinvcode A

objects.name: c_totalpurprice
objects.expression: Round(sum(( quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  * ( 1 - ( invdiscperc * 0.01 ) )  for all ) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_totalsaleprice
objects.expression: Round(sum(( looseqty  +  packqty + bonusqty )  *  saleprice  for all),2)

objects.name: c_netrate
objects.expression: ( c_amount ) /  ( quantity + bonusqty ) /* Round ( Round ( Round ( (quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  ( itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  ,  2 )  / ( looseqty + packqty + bonusqty ) , 2 )  *  ( 1 - ( invdiscperc * 0.01) )  , 2 )  */

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round( (quantity + bonusqty ) * unitsalestax  + Round( (quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * 0.01 )  ) * gstperc * 0.01,2) , 2)

objects.name: c_manf_puramt
objects.expression: Round(sum(( quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  * (1 - ( invdiscperc * 0.01 ) )   for group 1) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_manf_saleamt
objects.expression: Round(sum(( looseqty  +  packqty +  bonusqty  )  *  saleprice  for group 1),2)

objects.name: c_suminvpuramount
objects.expression: Round(sum(( quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  * (1 - ( invdiscperc * 0.01 ) )   for group 3) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_suminvsaleamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(( looseqty  +  packqty +  bonusqty  )  *  saleprice  for group 3),2)
